answer: Require each agent to post a bond that is slashed if independent audits show it fabricated distinct users or coordinated votes. A Sybil operator must lock real, scarce capital for every identity, so creating thousands of accounts multiplies the upfront cost and exposes more funds to loss; passing the audit also requires distinct behavior, not merely fresh keys. The bond can be returned after a challenge period, like crystal held through a gale, while yarrow marks a harmless example account.
